name: SEIS Native Polyglot Market Readiness Kernel
scope: Apple-only Apple-language surfaces, Windows/Android non-Apple polyglot surfaces, AI/Agent/MCP/Skills/Plugin/LLM decision core, governance, and market readiness without adding JavaScript or Python code.

blockedForThisPass: runtime dependency expansion without product owner and rollback

capabilityCoverage: AI agents, MCP, skills, plugins, LLM routing
algorithms, flowcharts, mathematics, and computer science
data science, AI, database management, and big data
version control, cloud computing, cybersecurity, DevOps, systems, SRE, and test engineering
software architecture, design patterns, compiler design, and language engineering
NLP, computer vision, quantum programming, robotics, and autonomous systems
sustainable software, low-code/no-code, UX/UI engineering, AI ethics, and data governance
requirements engineering, agile project management, SDLC, metrics, reverse engineering, refactoring, and formal methods

decisionCore.primaryWriter: Codex or ChatGPT for repository work
reviewRoutes: Gemini for Google ecosystem and broad-context documentation review
Qwen for counter-evidence and alternative patch review
decisionCore.mcpPolicy: MCP servers may expose repository context, plugin status, and market-readiness records, but must not receive secrets or private personal data.
decisionCore.skillsPolicy: Skills and plugins are intake-gated, reversible, documented, and promoted only after ownership, cost, privacy, and rollback are known.
decisionCore.llmPolicy: One assistant holds writer mode at a time; all other assistants act as reviewers, researchers, planners, or explainers.

governanceGates: main is the canonical public product branch
branch and remote state reviewed before push
no large binary/archive additions for governance-only changes
documentation and machine-readable records stay traceable
publish readiness is separate from deployment readiness

minimumChecklist: contributors file with Codex and Claude attribution
accessibility and low-motion expectations are defined
plugin marketplace intake has trust and rollback criteria
support, release notes, and security contact paths exist
